list: The official 55 PS5 trophies: 1 Platinum, 2 Gold, 6 Silver, 46 Bronze; 28 hidden; all single-player

roadmap.text: Twelve trophies pop just for finishing the story: the opening mission, four chapter trophies, the final mission and six mission trophies. There is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so keep one manual save at the start of every chapter and one untouched save from just before the final mission (the game has 15 manual slots plus an autosave). In Chapter 1, do Lucia's balcony meditation — it counts toward Positive Mental Attitude and is gone once the chapter ends. In Chapter 3, do Race Against Yago the moment it appears: it is time-sensitive and counts toward Strangers & Freaks.
roadmap.title: Play the story — and save at every chapter

roadmap.text: Six characters have questlines that end in a trophy (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret), plus the Strangers & Freaks strand count. Every one of them stays available after the story, so there is no rush — except Race Against Yago in Chapter 3. Note that Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's strands do not count toward Strangers & Freaks, because they have their own trophies; Andy's strand is Lucia-only, Tyrone's and Bret's are Jason-only.
roadmap.title: Side stories — all stay open after the credits

roadmap.text: Five trophies come from robbing places. Jewelry stores open in Chapter 3 (the Snap Gun comes from Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs); bank vaults open near the end of Chapter 4 (That's Where The Money Is). Rob three shops in a row with your partner, take a 4-star wanted level with your partner, and rob one illegal operation from each of the nine gangs.
roadmap.title: Robberies — the tools arrive in Chapters 3 and 4

roadmap.text: Try all 9 activity types once, win 20 different races and a drone race at every one of the 14 Top Fun locations, gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges, beat Cal at fishing, finish an arcade game, and pile up stunts — 250 for Cunning Stunts, but keep going to 300, because 100% completion needs it. Meditate at every spot (18 spots) and take down 5 enemies in one Combat Focus.
roadmap.title: Activities, races and stunts

roadmap.text: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts, spend $100,000 across all shops, buy all eight garages (about $160,000, after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver), register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, complete 3 Collectible Card sets, discover 100 vehicles with the WAiNK app, WAiNK It at 100 locations, and explore all of Leonida.
roadmap.title: Money, property and collections

roadmap.text: The last stretch is the 100% checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion), which only appears after the story — but work done earlier still counts. Its big numbers are 300 stunts, 70 of 80 Challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles, all 8 bank vaults and all 39 illegal operations. The five cryptic trophies (In The Beginning…, Capital Offense, Bad Luck, I Guess, The Truth Is Out There, Ten Pin) have no confirmed method at launch; their descriptions are the only hint, and some may pop while you play normally. Finish the checklist and A Long Road pops, then Vice Got a Price! — around 200 hours in total, difficulty about 4/10. Never use cheats on your trophy save: they should switch off trophies and saving.
roadmap.title: Odd moments, the 100% checklist and the Platinum

trophies.guide: The Platinum. It pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours — there is nothing extra to do for this one. Plan the whole list around A Long Road, the 100% Gold, because that is the longest road to the Platinum: roughly 200 hours, most of it the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
tips: The bar at the top of this guide counts all 54 — the Platinum is the 55th.
For most hunters A Long Road is the last trophy before this one pops.

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission, and it pops. Nothing to prepare — just play the prologue.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
tips: Pops during the opening mission; no preparation needed.

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy for finishing Chapter 1. Before the chapter ends, do Lucia's balcony meditation: after Lucia is home, check the kitchen in the morning and follow her out to the balcony of Jason's house. It counts toward Positive Mental Attitude and disappears once Chapter 1 ends, so keep a Chapter 1 manual save until that trophy pops.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
tips: Keep a manual save from the start of Chapter 1.
Do the balcony meditation before the chapter ends — it does not come back.

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy for finishing Chapter 2. Switching between Jason and Lucia should open during this chapter, which opens up most of the free-roam list — the two of them together are needed for the partner trophies. The Vice City Real Estate app (garages) unlocks after the mission Daily Driver, and the Scooter Bros app opens with the mission Moses.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
tips: Keep a manual save from the start of Chapter 2.
After Daily Driver, garages are buyable; after Moses, vehicles are registerable.

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy for finishing Chapter 3. One thing inside this chapter is time-sensitive: Race Against Yago, in Yago's street-racing strand, carries an hourglass icon — do it the moment it appears, because the strand counts toward Strangers & Freaks. The Snap Gun also arrives in this chapter (Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs), which opens jewelry store robberies for Sneakthief.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
tips: Keep a manual save from the start of Chapter 3.
Do Race Against Yago as soon as it appears — it is time-sensitive.

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy for finishing Chapter 4. Near the end of this chapter, the optional mission That's Where The Money Is opens bank vaults — that is the key to Maximum Withdrawal and, with your partner along, to Hot Together.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
tips: Keep a manual save from the start of Chapter 4.
Do That's Where The Money Is before the final mission if you can.

trophies.guide: The final story mission, worth a Gold. Keep one untouched manual save from just before it — there is no mission replay, so that save is your only way back to the story's end. After the credits the 100% checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, and everything outside the story stays available.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
tips: Save manually right before the final mission and do not overwrite that slot.
After the credits, the whole map stays open for cleanup.

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Finish the mission Breakfast Run and it pops as you play; there is no side requirement and nothing to prepare.
trophies.name: Trust
tips: Story mission — just play through it.

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Finish the mission The Cartel Heist and it pops as you play; there is no side requirement and nothing to prepare.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
tips: Story mission — just play through it.

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Finish the mission Child's Play and it pops as you play; there is no side requirement and nothing to prepare.
trophies.name: Family Matters
tips: Story mission — just play through it.

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Finish the mission Headliners and it pops as you play; there is no side requirement and nothing to prepare.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
tips: Story mission — just play through it.

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Finish the mission VCIA Takedown and it pops as you play; there is no side requirement and nothing to prepare.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
tips: Story mission — just play through it.

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Finish the mission Operation Savage Glory and it pops as you play; there is no side requirement and nothing to prepare.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
tips: Story mission — just play through it.

trophies.guide: The 100% Gold — the longest trophy on the list. The checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story, but work you do earlier still counts. The big numbers: 300 stunts, 70 of the 80 Challenges, 200 of the 277 vehicles, all 8 bank vaults and all 39 illegal operations. That is why the Platinum takes around 200 hours: most of it is this checklist.
trophies.name: A Long Road
tips: Keep grinding past the trophy thresholds: 300 stunts (not 250), 70 Challenges (not 50).
Check the in-game checklist after the credits to see exactly what is left.

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count. Do not stop at 250 — A Long Road needs 300, so keep every stunt spot in your rotation until the checklist is done.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
tips: Stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count.
Keep going to 300 stunts for 100% completion.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once — 9 types in total. Sample the activities as you meet them (races, fishing, the shooting range, the arcade, the gym and the rest) instead of grinding one: one try of each is all it takes.
trophies.name: Master of None
tips: Nine activity types; one try of each pops it.
Fishing, arcade and gym visits count here too.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges. Two shooting ranges share 42 gold medals between them. Work through the challenges range by range; gold times are the hard part of this Silver, so bring your best aim and take the challenges one at a time.
trophies.name: The Shootist
tips: Two ranges, 42 gold medals between them.
Retry a challenge until the gold medal lands — progress saves per challenge.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — 14 locations, and you need at least one win at each. Learn each course's line first; a win anywhere counts, so clear the easy locations early and come back for the tricky ones.
trophies.name: Top Fun
tips: Fourteen drone race locations; one win at each.
Wins count per location, not per race — spread them around.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any 20 distinct races count — street races, drone races and the rest — so race whatever is nearby and keep count as you go. Races you win for other trophies (Top Fun, Yago's strand) count here too.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
tips: Twenty distinct race wins; repeats of the same race do not count twice.
Street races and drone races both count.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge and out-fish him — steady reeling and the right spot matter more than speed. Fishing is also one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
tips: Take the fishing challenge against Cal and beat his catch.
Fishing counts as an activity type too.

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Find any arcade cabinet, play one game through to its end, and the trophy pops. It is a quick one — do it whenever you pass an arcade.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
tips: Any arcade cabinet works; finish one full game.
Counts as an activity type for Master of None.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's questline is Lucia-only and stays open after the credits, so there is no rush. Note that Andy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks — it has its own trophy instead.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
tips: Lucia-only strand; play it as Lucia.
Stays available after the story.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton's questline stays open after the credits, so finish it whenever you like during cleanup.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
tips: Stays available after the story.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's questline stays open after the credits. Like Andy's and Tyrone's, it does not count toward Strangers & Freaks — it has its own trophy instead.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
tips: Stays available after the story.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only some questlines count: Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's do not, because they have their own trophies. Check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish so you know which ones counted. One strand is time-sensitive: Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 carries an hourglass icon — do it the moment it appears.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
tips: Eight strands; Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's do not count.
Race Against Yago (Chapter 3) is time-sensitive — do it at once.
Check the progress counter after each strand.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's questline stays open after the credits, so finish it whenever you like during cleanup.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
tips: Stays available after the story.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's questline is Jason-only and stays open after the credits. It does not count toward Strangers & Freaks — it has its own trophy instead.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
tips: Jason-only strand; play it as Jason.
Stays available after the story.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in 10 locations, according to the launch-week guides. Meditation spots show as purple icons when you are close. Each outdoor spot counts twice if you meditate there with both characters, so bring your partner every time. The catch: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 disappears after that chapter, so do it while you are still in Chapter 1 and keep a Chapter 1 save until this trophy pops.
trophies.missableNote: The one potentially missable trophy: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 disappears after that chapter. Do it in Chapter 1 and keep a Chapter 1 save until this trophy pops.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
tips: MISSABLE: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 — do it before the chapter ends.
18 spots in 10 locations; spots show as purple icons nearby.
Bring your partner: an outdoor spot counts twice if both meditate there.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only and sends you after animals through target decks. A clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine, which is what the hunt wants.
trophies.name: Fair Game
tips: Jason-only strand; play it as Jason.
Aim for a clean head or heart shot to keep the carcass pristine.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida; finish any three full sets and the Silver pops. Work on sets as you explore rather than hunting one set at a time — duplicates and stray cards add up across the map.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
tips: Any three completed sets count.
Pick up cards as you explore; sets finish on their own over time.

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Open the WAiNK app and tag spots as you travel — a hundred tags across Leonida. Scanning vehicles with WAiNK also counts as discovering them, which feeds Whip It Good, so scan traffic as you drive and the two trophies progress together.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
tips: Tag 100 locations with the WAiNK app.
Scan traffic with WAiNK while driving — it counts toward discovering vehicles too.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are listed under Progress > Challenges, and many complete on their own while you play. Do not stop at 50: A Long Road needs 70 of the 80, so keep the challenge list open during cleanup and pick off the ones nearest to done.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
tips: Challenges live under Progress > Challenges.
Keep going to 70 of 80 for 100% completion.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. The easiest pairing is a bank vault job, which hands you a 4-star Wanted Level straight away — escape with your partner and the trophy pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area.
trophies.name: Hot Together
tips: Pair it with a bank vault job: instant 4 stars, partner already with you.
It pops once you leave the red heat zone.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Call your partner, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you. If the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop, so give it a moment before hitting a fourth.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
tips: Keep the Wanted Level alive across all three robberies.
Wait ~30 seconds after the third shop — the pop is delayed.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive instead of hunting vehicles one by one. For 100% completion you need 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning long after this one pops.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
tips: Scan traffic with the WAiNK app while driving.
Keep going to 200 of 277 vehicles for 100% completion.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim — press L3 and R3 while aiming. Pick a group of gang enemies, such as the guards at an illegal operation, and use an assault rifle. Adrenaline extends Focus, so chain your shots while it lasts.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
tips: Combat Focus: L3 + R3 while aiming.
Gang guards at an illegal operation make a good group of five.
Adrenaline extends Focus — use it.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. At Vice City International Airport, steal a large passenger plane that is docked at a boarding bridge — the planes at gates E3 and E4 work, while planes parked out on the airfield do not count. Go up to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off, then fly about 1 km away from the airport; the pop is delayed. Save first, because the police come fast.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
tips: Take a jet at a boarding bridge (gates E3 and E4 work).
Fly about 1 km from the airport — the pop is delayed.
Save first; the police come fast.

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos — get into a military tank. Tanks should be parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, get in, and drive and fire until it pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
tips: Tanks sit on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station (far southwest island).
Save first, then drive and fire until it pops.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies. Go to a store's locked back door and use the Snap Gun on it — kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target. If someone spots you, reload rather than push on.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
tips: Snap Gun on the back door — never kick it in.
Read the note for the safe code, then leave unseen.
If spotted, reload the save.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Bank vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4: tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. You cannot carry all the bags alone, so bring your partner. A vault job gives you a 4-star Wanted Level straight away, so escaping one with your partner also earns Hot Together. The 100% checklist needs all eight vaults.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
tips: Unlocks via That's Where The Money Is (near the end of Chapter 4).
Bring your partner — you cannot carry all the bags alone.
Escaping also earns Hot Together; 100% needs all 8 vaults.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Tail or ambush an armored truck, take it, and escape the heat — the trophy pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
tips: Take an armored truck, then escape the heat completely.
It pops once you leave the red heat zone.

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Cover every area of the map — driving and flying through each region fills it in. Fold it into your other travel: every trip to a mission, a race or a collectible also counts toward the map.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
tips: Drive and fly through every region; the map fills in as you go.
Fold it into other travel instead of grinding it alone.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — one operation from each of the nine gangs. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so this trophy pops along the way while you clear them.
trophies.name: Pest Control
tips: Nine gangs, one operation each.
100% needs all 39 operations, so it pops on the way.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. No confirmed unlock method at launch — the description is the only hint, and the trophy may pop while you play normally. The plain reading: order a cocktail at a beachfront spot on Ocean Beach and take in the view.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
tips: No confirmed method at launch — the description is the only hint.
Try a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. No confirmed method at launch — the description is the only hint. The plain reading: drive a car out through a showroom's glass front, the classic GTA way. Try it during normal play and watch for the pop.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
tips: No confirmed method at launch — the description is the only hint.
Try driving a car out through a showroom's glass front.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. The alley is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs and take all three key valuables: the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb. Then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later — so this one is not missable.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
tips: Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation in Chapter 2.
Take all three valuables: watch, shotgun, office safe (Sticky Bomb).
Not missable — the operation returns if you miss a valuable.

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. Community guides report it pops when Jason and Lucia both reach maximum Strength — buy a gym membership and train with your partner, since the partner trains alongside you. The method is not yet fully confirmed at launch, so treat it as the best current reading, not a guarantee.
trophies.name: Personal Best
tips: Reported method: both characters at maximum Strength.
Train at a gym with your partner alongside you.
Method not yet fully confirmed at launch.

trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). Community guides report this counts 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind — just play the game and it lands.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
tips: Reported count: 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile.
Robberies and fights feed it; it fills up during normal play.

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. No confirmed method at launch — the description hints at succeeding on a second attempt at something. Likely pops during normal play; keep playing and watch for it after a retry goes right.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
tips: No confirmed method at launch — the description is the only hint.
Likely tied to succeeding on a second attempt.

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? No confirmed method at launch — the description hints at a strange encounter or easter egg somewhere in Leonida. The description is the only hint; it likely pops when you stumble into something weird while exploring.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
tips: No confirmed method at launch — the description is the only hint.
Likely tied to a strange encounter while exploring Leonida.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a drive-by with a melee weapon. The precise method is still being confirmed at launch, so try a slow drive-by with a melee weapon equipped and watch for the pop.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
tips: Melee drive-by: knock someone down from a moving vehicle.
Precise method still being confirmed at launch.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from bank and payday loan jobs; sell them to your contacts to launder them. The $250,000 total is cumulative, so it builds across every job.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
tips: Marked Bills come from bank and payday loan jobs.
Launder them by selling to your contacts; the total is cumulative.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative across every kind of shop, so it adds up on its own over a full playthrough — weapons, clothes, food and the rest all count.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
tips: Cumulative across every kind of shop.
Builds on its own over a full playthrough.

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy the eight garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver; together they cost about $160,000. Garages the story gives you do not count. Buy them early — you need the free spaces to register cars for On the Spot.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
tips: Eight garages, about $160,000 in total.
Unlocks after Daily Driver (Chapter 2); story garages do not count.
Buy early — registrations need free garage spaces.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the app: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars.
trophies.name: On the Spot
tips: Opens with the Chapter 2 mission Moses.
Respray, then Register; from Chapter 3, Pay 'n' Spray works too.
Each car needs a free garage space — buy garages first.
